financings_after_balance_sheet.what: July 2026 public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants, including full exercise of the underwriters' option
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The aggregate net proceeds received from the offering were approximately $107.8 million, net of underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses.

warrants.quote: the Company also issued HCR warrants to purchase 268,096 shares of its common stock at an exercise price per share of $14.92
